description: Machine-readable declaration of the cross-field semantic rules that back the JSON Schemas but cannot be expressed in 2020-12 (no sibling-field comparison). Consumers receive this document in the contract archive; the producer conformance runner implements exactly these rule ids and fails if the set drifts (single source of truth, M01).

rules.constraint: 0 <= point.x <= imageDimensions.widthPx AND 0 <= point.y <= imageDimensions.heightPx, per candidate, in the candidate's declared coordinateSpace
region.x >= 0 AND region.y >= 0 AND region.x + region.w <= widthPx AND region.y + region.h <= heightPx, per candidate
crop.x >= 0 AND crop.y >= 0 AND crop.x + crop.w <= widthPx AND crop.y + crop.h <= heightPx
